description: LLM-only baseline for the benchmark: ask a language model for the four picks of each brief, with no rule engine.

frontend: Mobile toolkit; web is a target, so the primary frontend is a web framework (mobile app suggested as companion)

database: In-memory store: ~220 GB within 12 months cannot sensibly live in RAM as the system of record (use it as a cache)

In-memory store: with the default append-only-file setting (fsync every second) a crash loses up to the last second of writes, and snapshots alone lose minutes; it holds key-value data but not tables of records: your relational data needs a durable general-purpose primary store, with Redis / Valkey beside it as a supporting store

hosting: Only for read-only sites; your users sign in, post or pay
